posts.text: This fall, I had the opportunity to teach a course where students designed, built, and battled combat robots, and it has been one of the most fulfilling experiences I’ve had as an undergrad at UCLA. In 10 weeks, Nandana V. and I led undergraduate engineers in lectures on design principles, SolidWorks, manufacturing, 3D printing, electronics, and robot assembly, culminating in a final BattleBots-style tournament.
